Stock Structures - MPSKU New Stock Structure (1/2)
Stock is linked to MPSKU model id; still
on model-level and will be location-based
In this new stock structure, we track stock quantity on both MPSKU model and location basis
Each location has a location id; location id always starts with region of location (e.g. IDE = stock location in ID)
There are 2 main types of locations; seller location, warehouse location
Seller location = Refers to stock in seller-managed location
There is one default seller location in every region that Shopee operates in
Warehouse location = Refers to Shopee warehouses; i.e. warehouses managed by Shopee
Warehouse stock has 3 stock types and
For warehouse stock, the 3 types are:
Locked stock = Stock is locked when order is unpaid or paid but WMS hasn't successfully sourced the stock yet
Reserved stock = Reserved stock for promotions or virtual SKUs
Sellable stock = Physical stock value; actual stock quantity in warehouse location
For seller stock, only has Reserved Stock and Sellable Stock, but no Locked Stock as we assume all seller stock sourced
Available stock = sellable - reserved - locked (if applicable)
have a separate table to store reserve stock breakdown by
Stock Structures - MPSKU New Stock Structure (2/2)
• We have a special type of location id called virtual location id that is only used in TH
The location id THO is used to represent all Shopee warehouses in TH for 2 reasons
• Even if items are shipped from different warehouses, FE shows that it is shipped from one location and hence user
only pays one shipping fee; Shopee absorbs the additional shipping costs
• Flexibility in fulfilling reserved stock orders; Order Management System (OMS) can decide which actual warehouse
• By default, promotions with reserved stock for normal SKUs and reserved mode VSKUs will use floating mode
Floating mode means that the promo reserved stock is not fixed reserved at a specific location, but rather just reserved
on model-level and it is up to Order / supply chain side to decide the best location to fulfil from
Floating promo is currently only available in certain regions and for specific item types, details here
• For fixed reserved, it means that promo reserved stock is fixed reserved at stock locations
There are 2 types for this - based on a hardcoded priority or at specific locations
Refer "Stock service multi-whs priority config" here for priority
• Order will call OMS APl to determine which warehouse(s) Order should fulfill orders from; however, if OMS is not
responding (AP| call failed), Order will use this same hardcoded priority as fallback logic

Exception case of ID taxable sellers
All CN CB sellers in ID, SG, MY as well as some ID sellers based in free tax zone (e.g. Batam) are taxable sellers
Previously, due to import tax issue, seller location and warehouse location cannot fulfil the same order; this is because
depending on location stock is fulfilled from, price will be different
However, with recent policy changes, ID taxable sellers can no longer be on PFF
Hence, when they sign up for FBS, they need to select either 1) ship all items in their shop to local ID warehouse (this will be
full FBS), 2) only ship out from CN seller location
If they choose CN seller location, they will not be able to join FBS anymore
Currently, virtual SKUs can only be managed by Shopee via Item Shopee Admin; sellers cannot create / edit VSKUs
VSKUs can only be fulfilled from warehouse locations
VSKUs can only be created with MTSKU parents, cannot be created with MPSKU parents anymore since Q3 2022
Each VSKU can have up to 10 parent MTSKUs
Each parent MTSKU can be included in up to 50 normal status and 80 all status VSKUs
Stock mode of VSKU can be selected
There are 2 different types of stock mode; once stock mode is selected during VSKU creation, it cannot be changed
Weak mode: Max out the number of VSKUs based on parent SKU with lower stock
Reserved mode: Reserve specific volume of parent SKUs for VSKUs in specific warehouse location
If child VSKU is on reserved mode and item status of child VSKU changes from normal / normal unlist to any other status (e.g
offensive_hide, deleted), then the reserved mode stock quantity will become 0
• If child VSKU becomes normal status, VSKU is still in reserved mode and user needs to re-reserve stock again
